scripts.build:site: npm run build:css && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.dev: npm run build:css && concurrently --kill-others --names css,jekyll "npm run watch:css" "bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.serve: npm run build:css && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --host 0.0.0.0
